evidence.artifact_manifest_sha256: [VM 기입] smoke-1c/artifact-sha256.json (root writes it; RUN_MANIFEST.json smoke.artifact_manifest_sha256)

start_trigger.selection_caveat: smoke seeds were chosen from earlier r13 successes (SMOKE.md); the trigger only shows the path can succeed, it is not an unbiased yield estimate. The pilot run (seeds.pilot) is the unselected yield measurement.

unit.rule: one attempt = one pair episode (both robots, one seed, one bin). Every count N/S/A/E below is in pair episodes, never robot rows or streams. A pair episode contributes two robot streams to the tensors only when admitted.

world.complete: behavior: judged; in the denominator N (includes end_reason cap_end, planning_wall_safety_cap and teacher_terminal mission failures)
world.HOST_ERROR: environment: excluded from N, counted in E.host_error, seed consumed, re-queued once (same seed, same bin)
world.running: environment: as HOST_ERROR (result.json written before the final update)
world.missing: environment: world absent from summary.worlds or no raw result.json; as HOST_ERROR

batch.clean: summary.status == complete AND summary.HOST_ERROR == 0 AND episode command exit code == 0 (exit-try-<n>.json present) AND summary.rejection_table is an absolute path
batch.admission_rejected: environment: every un-ingested slot -> E.admission_error, seed consumed, NOT re-queued (the case is deterministic)
batch.HOST_ERROR_or_exit_nonzero_or_unknown_ex: unclean: worlds present in summary.worlds are judged (behavior, in N and S) but NEVER admitted (audit 1); worlds missing -> environment host_error
batch.interrupted_twice: after MAX_TRIES=2 tries without a final summary the remaining slots are environment host_error (closed as unclean)

result_after_grasp: carry (dict with outcome and events list)
carry_eval (dict with success bool, failure, drop_events list, robot_robot_contact_ticks int)
required_fields.missing_or_wrong_type: record_error: the attempt is neither success nor failure, it is rejected; STOP_RECORD stops collection after that batch (no defaults such as 0 drops or physical_success fallback)

success.physical_success_S: world status complete AND grasp_physical_success is true AND carry_eval.success is true AND carry_eval.drop_events == [] AND carry_eval.robot_robot_contact_ticks == 0 (P2 evaluator harness/pair_carry_eval.evaluate unchanged)
success.truth_scope: GT is read only by the eval-only evaluator after the episode; never by the teacher controller or student inputs

filter.admitted_A: S AND search_handoff == false AND approach_handoff == false AND batch clean AND (training) data_admitted == true AND (training) both robot streams pass the stage sidecar check
filter.sidecar_check: per robot r1/r2: teacher-<rid>.jsonl(.zst) and student-<rid>.jsonl(.zst) exist, every teacher row has sample_id and a teacher_phase mapped by harness.pairact_r1.TEACHER_PHASE_TO_STAGE, teacher sample_id set == student sample_id set, >= 1 row. Run at ingest, before the attempt row is written; eligible/admitted is counted only after both robots pass
filter.measurement_mode: no recording -> no sidecar; A in pilot is 'admission candidate' (S AND no handoff AND batch clean) and is labelled '수율 측정, 시연 아님'
filter.success_not_admitted: S but not A: counted in S, tagged success_not_admitted:<reasons> (handoff, batch_not_clean, recording_not_admitted, sidecar_failed), never in tensors
filter.failures: never enter tensors; raw outputs are kept untouched in the batch directories and listed in the ledger with failure stage and carry sub-reason
filter.no_relabel: the filter is a pure function of result.json / summary.json / stream fields named above; no manual selection, no re-judging after viewing videos

carry_failure_detail.why: world 1 of smoke-1c (seed 8420001) failed not_through_door with 0.6 mm displacement and an unknown cause (02-world1-failure.md); the evaluator label is a priority label, not a root cause
fields_per_attempt: eval_failure (carry_eval.failure: drop, robot_robot_contact, not_through_door, not_in_zone, not_resting, not_released, not_still)
carry_outcome (teacher carry.outcome as written, e.g. route_blocked, door_pass_timeout, carry_total_timeout, command_sequence_complete)
carry_fail (last carry.events entry with event == fail: code, phase, detail)
carry_failure_detail.report: per bin table of failure_stage:eval_failure:carry_outcome counts

recording_admission.approved_by: carry owner (Claude), 2026-10-21 answer to task c46a4652
recording_admission.change: ONLY the '>=38/40 teacher gate' requirement of the teacher recording admission is replaced by: sha256 of this pre-registration equals the value passed to the run, and status == FROZEN. A non-FROZEN pre-registration refuses recording.
kept_unchanged: paired 640x480 recording-mode check (>=3 same starts, recording off vs recording probe on the same machine, both physical_success, rgb_size [640,480], rgb_hz 10, same source/profile/modes): data validity of the training input vs the student camera, not teacher reliability
visible_only + issued pose + visible_handoff_v1 recording requirements
data_admitted excludes search/approach handoffs and recording probes
recording_admission.check_scope: metadata and physical-result comparison only; it does not verify pixel content, measured cadence or trajectory identity (Codex follow-up REVIEW.md)
recording_admission.stack: RUN_MANIFEST.json stack (teacher -c, adapter -a-c, root -r-c SHAs); RUN_MANIFEST.json is frozen together with this file
recording_admission.default_off: existing candidates and the gate path are byte-identical (regression tests in each -c branch)
recording_admission.fallback: if the recording path fails on the VM the first time, only the pilot measurement run is done (seeds.pilot, recording off, candidate pairact_p2_r13) and reported as '수율 측정, 시연 아님'

bins.unit: pair episode; both robots of one attempt are drawn inside the same bin (not independent robot-level uniform draws)
bins.distance: planar distance from the robot spawn to the grasp point of its assigned beam end (start_layers.<rid>.target_distance_m)
bins.yaw: own heading offset relative to the assigned-end outward direction (wide_start convention). facing: wrapped offset within 90 deg of pi (robot looks at its end); away: otherwise
bins.roles: r1 end = teal if random.Random('pairact_r1_collect_v1:<seed>:role').random() < 0.5 else blue (not seed parity, which would tie roles to round-robin bins)
bins.position_bearing: radially outward from the assigned end (wide_start bearing bin 0), unchanged from the r13 wide gate
bins.draw_within_bin: per robot: distance uniform in the bin range, yaw offset uniform in the bin half-circle, rng = random.Random('pairact_r1_collect_v1:<seed>:<bin id>:<robot index>') (str seed, sha512, independent of PYTHONHASHSEED) [setup only]

bin_limit.rule: at a batch boundary, a bin with N_b >= 20 attempts and S_b / N_b < 0.20 (physical carry success rate) gets a ledger row bin_limited and receives no further new attempts (re-queues of its own HOST_ERROR seeds still run). It is reported as '구간 범위 제한' with its N_b, S_b, A_b and failure sub-reasons. Closing is permanent for the run root
bin_limit.rationale: at 20 attempts and < 20% success the expected attempts to reach 20 admitted exceed 100 (~1/6 of the cap) for one bin; spending them would starve the other bins. 20 attempts keeps the binomial 95% upper bound of a 3/20 rate (~0.38) below the 33% yield the cap of 600 assumes

targets.not_a_denominator: 200 is the admitted target and a stop condition, never a denominator. Reports use S/N and A/N (N = behavior attempts) and validation S/20, A/20
targets.attempt_definition: N counts behavior attempts only (status table). Environment failures consume their seed but are not attempts
targets.overshoot: a batch that crosses 200 runs to its end; every admitted episode of that batch is kept (no trimming, trimming would be a selection)
targets.rationale: 200 = TRAIN200 of solo ACT R8 and close to beamact2's 185 successful pairs; 150 = 75% of it, the smallest set the success-filter decision accepts; 600 = 200 / 0.33 assumed yield (decision doc 3); 20 per bin x 6 = 120 < 150, so the per-bin minimum and the total minimum are separate AND conditions; 80 = training floor (owner 2026-10-21, fixed before any result): below it no training, back to P2
targets.replaces_decision_doc: the decision document's '진행 가능한 최소치 150' (pairact-success-filter-decision.md section 3) is replaced by the four training_decision tiers; 150 now separates TRAIN* from TRAIN_SMALL_DATA and 80 is the no-training floor

stop_rules.order: evaluated at every batch boundary in this order; the first true rule stops train collection
list: STOP_RECORD: any record_error attempt (missing/ill-typed required field, unregistered status, summary/result carry disagreement)
STOP_HOST: the last two finished train batches are both unclean (status table batch)
STOP_DISTANCE: A >= 150 and the distance gate fails on the current admitted set (checked at every boundary from then on)
STOP_TARGET: A >= 200 and every bin has A_b >= 20 or is bin_limited
STOP_SEEDS: every train seed (8340000-8340599) is consumed and no train re-queue is pending
stop_rules.seed_consumption_note: environment failures consume seeds without adding to N, so STOP_SEEDS can occur with N < 600 (e.g. 600 seeds / 599 attempts after one final HOST_ERROR). STOP_SEEDS is treated exactly like STOP_CAP; there is no seed range beyond 8340599 and no replacement seed

training_decision.rule: after a train stop: NO_TRAIN_RECORD_ERROR if STOP_RECORD; else NO_TRAIN_BELOW_FLOOR if A < 80; else NO_TRAIN_DISTANCE_GATE if the distance gate fails on the final admitted set; else the tiers above (TRAIN_SMALL_DATA if A < 150, TRAIN_DATA_RANGE_LIMITED if some bin < 20, TRAIN otherwise). Then validation runs for any TRAIN* decision and the validation gate may turn it into NO_TRAIN_VALIDATION_INSUFFICIENT

per_stop.STOP_TARGET: TRAIN, or TRAIN_DATA_RANGE_LIMITED when some bin is bin_limited
per_stop.STOP_CAP: tiers 1-4 on the admitted set: A >= 150 -> TRAIN / TRAIN_DATA_RANGE_LIMITED; 80 <= A < 150 -> TRAIN_SMALL_DATA; A < 80 -> NO_TRAIN_BELOW_FLOOR (back to P2, report)
per_stop.STOP_SEEDS: same as STOP_CAP (N may be < 600 because environment failures consumed seeds)
per_stop.STOP_HOST: same as STOP_CAP on the attempts so far; the run root is closed for train collection. Validation is run only by a later invocation with --validation-after-host-fix after DeepSeek reports the host fix; its own HOST_ERRORs follow the status table
per_stop.STOP_DISTANCE: NO_TRAIN_DISTANCE_GATE; stop and report, no extra collection and no post-hoc seed selection
per_stop.STOP_RECORD: NO_TRAIN_RECORD_ERROR; the recorder/judge is fixed and a NEW run root with a new prereg revision is used

training_decision.data_range_limited_label: results on TRAIN_DATA_RANGE_LIMITED (or TRAIN_SMALL_DATA with bins < 20) carry '데이터 범위 제한(구간 부족: <bin list>)' with each bin's A_b; TRAIN_SMALL_DATA results also carry '소량 데이터(A<150)'
tiers: 1. A >= 150 AND every bin A_b >= 20 -> TRAIN (normal)
2. A >= 150 AND some bin A_b < 20 -> TRAIN_DATA_RANGE_LIMITED; every result carries '데이터 범위 제한(구간 부족: <bin list>)'

3. 80 <= A < 150 -> TRAIN_SMALL_DATA; every result carries '소량 데이터(A<150)' (plus the range label if bins < 20) and interpretation is limited to the stage funnel. Rationale: with the 11/5 schedule one train+eval pass is needed to see the failing stage, and training (~4.6 GPU-h) costs less than a collection retry. Fixed before seeing any result
4. A < 80 -> NO_TRAIN_BELOW_FLOOR: no training; return to the P2 teacher carry path and report it
training_decision.owner_answer: 2026-10-21 owner answer to task 11cb2d69: interpretation (가) plus the 80 floor (tiers above)

allocation.adaptive: adaptive collection: the bin of the next train attempt depends on earlier outcomes. Seeds are consumed in strict ascending order independent of the bin, so the start of a seed depends on the ledger. Yields are therefore adaptive-collection yields, not the yield of the original robot-level uniform start distribution; reports give per-bin tables and primary (8340000-199) vs extension (8340200-599) tables separately
allocation.batch_size: fixed per run root (--batch-size, default 20); recorded in the ledger header
allocation.quantity: success_b in every rule below is A_b (admitted, the same quantity as the stop rules); N_b is behavior attempts
allocation.warmup: while ANY open bin has N_b < 4: slots are round-robin over the open bins B0..B5 continuing after the last assigned bin (implementation = document)
allocation.deficit: need_b = max(0, 20 - A_b); p_b = (A_b + 1) / (N_b + 2); weight_b = need_b / max(p_b, 0.05); bin_limited bins get weight 0. Slots split by largest remainder over weight_b, ties to the lower bin index
allocation.after_minimums: when every open bin has need_b == 0 but A < 200: round-robin over the open bins
allocation.slot_order: slots are interleaved bin by bin (B0,B1,..) so a partially run batch stays balanced
allocation.deterministic: allocation reads only the ledger; identical ledger -> identical next batch

constants_rationale.warmup_4: 4 attempts per bin (24 total, about one batch) before any rate is used: the Laplace estimate (A+1)/(N+2) is then within [1/6, 5/6] and cannot zero a bin
constants_rationale.p_floor_0.05: caps one bin's weight at 20x need so a 0/k bin cannot take a whole batch; the bin_limit rule, not the floor, retires a hopeless bin
constants_rationale.laplace: (A+1)/(N+2) is the posterior mean under a uniform prior; it is defined at N = 0

seeds.consumption: per split, new attempts take the next unused seed in strict ascending order regardless of bin; a HOST_ERROR re-queue reuses its own seed and bin and consumes no new seed; setup rejections and admission errors consume the seed and are never re-queued

pilot.rule: measurement mode only (recording off, candidate pairact_p2_r13): yield, bins and wall/SIM. Bin = (seed - 8343000) % 6, no adaptive allocation. Never in tensors, never pooled with A of the training run. Also the source of the 3 recording-probe starts

validation.rule: training mode only and only after the train stop (never during or before collection, never in measurement mode). Bin = index % 6, collected once each, HOST_ERROR re-queued once, not counted toward targets, cap or allocation; admitted episodes go to validation tensors

seeds.overlap_check: pilot, train, validation and heldout are pairwise disjoint and disjoint from seeds.json known_ranges (harness.pairact_collect.check_seed_ranges at load; scripts/check_pairact_r1_seeds.py --scan-refs for git refs, output saved as seed-check.json in the run root)

validation_gate.rule: after validation: admitted validation pairs >= 8 of 20 AND the union of sidecar stages over admitted validation episodes contains approach, alignment, ready, execute, carry, place, complete. Otherwise NO_TRAIN_VALIDATION_INSUFFICIENT: stop and report; no extra validation seeds, no replacement, no relaxing
validation_gate.rationale: OFFLINE_GATE G4 needs every registered transition present in validation and fails otherwise; 8 pairs = 16 robot streams give >= 16 instances per transition so the 0.80 recall threshold is resolved at 1/16; the required stages are the RUNBOOK section 2 missing_stages list (recover may be absent)
validation_gate.report: validation S/20 and A/20 with environment failures listed separately

dart_noise.mechanism: existing teacher --noise (result.noise = 'DART-inspired_fixed_pilot'): 5% of grasp-segment steps outside done/complete/ready apply a perturbed command; the label keeps clean_teacher_command and perturbed=true. Carry segment rows are never perturbed
dart_noise.when_on: a separate run root and ledger tag noise=on; every attempt records perturbed_rows / total_rows per robot; reports never pool noise-on and noise-off
dart_noise.trigger_candidate: only if recover-stage rows in admitted successes are < 5% of rows after collection; needs Claude approval and a new prereg revision
dart_noise.gpu_status: [확인 필요] the -c adapter keeps noise=False for every candidate

bias_report.ks: two-sample KS (asymptotic p) on PAIR-level values (mean of the two robots' start distance; mean |yaw offset|) between the three groups physical_failure, success_not_admitted, admitted (three pairwise comparisons); one value per pair episode because both robots share the bin. Informational, not a gate; conditional on the adaptive allocation
bias_report.per_bin_table: bin, N, S, A, S/N, A/N, need, environment failures by kind, setup rejections, bin_limited, failure sub-reasons; also split primary vs extension seeds
bias_report.recover_count: rows with teacher_phase mapped to stage recover in admitted episodes (sidecar)

distance_gate.applies_to: robot-level start distances of ADMITTED train pair episodes (both robots of every admitted pair)
distance_gate.rule: all nine 0.1 m bins of [0.3, 1.2] occupied AND share of distances > 0.8 m >= 25%
distance_gate.when: at every batch boundary once A >= 150 (STOP_DISTANCE) and on the final admitted set (training_decision)
distance_gate.on_failure: stop and report; no post-hoc seed selection, no extra collection, no relaxing
distance_gate.rationale: uniform 0.3-1.2 m gives 44% above 0.8 m; 25% keeps the beamact4 failure mode (TRAIN 0.09% above 0.8 m) out while allowing the far bins to be bin_limited

audit_outputs.ledger: every attempt (behavior or environment), every setup rejection (generator budget exhaustion included), bin_limited rows and batch_done rows with status, HOST_ERROR, exit code, rejection_table absolute path, artifact manifest sha256
audit_outputs.setup_rejection_row: seed, bin, split, gate funnel (per gate cumulative passed / rejected), blocked objects with counts, minimum gap (m) per gate, generator source sha and file sha256, reproduce command
audit_outputs.case_plan: every accepted case carries the same generator audit (gate funnel, blockers, min gaps, reproduce)
audit_outputs.episode_command: the --episode-cmd template must contain --rejection-table <absolute path> and --cap-s; template sha256, the input rejection table path and cap are in the ledger header
audit_outputs.batch_rejection_table: summary.rejection_table (absolute) is required for a clean batch
